name: multi_session__close_one_does_not_evict_other
description: Locks subscription-isolation across sessions: closing CASE session A must evict subscription A but leave subscription B untouched. The bridge wires two subscriptions on two different sessions (mirroring Apple Home + chip-tool both pairing the same accessory). Step 1 closes the first session. Steps 2-3 verify subscription 0 is silent (any outbound would be a regression where the manager closed all subscriptions on close_session). Steps 4-6 verify subscription 1 still ships a fresh-exchange ReportData on the F4 path, proving the close was scoped correctly.
